name: Ego
source:
Official name: Sexaroid Experimental Model E-5
Attributes: Android, sexophobia, stylish, rare
Talents: Sex (Reluctantly, she was made for it, but doesn't like it.)

A prototype sexaroid of Electro-Electronics, Inc.
Her model number is "E-5 (ERECT-type5)".

Ego is the 5th and lasted experimental model following her sisters type 1-4. For some reason, she has developed an ego of her own that her sisters don't have. Because of this, she dislikes sex.

She appears to be an expressionless android, but she actually has human feelings and emotions. Questioning her own role, she escaped from the research institute of her own accord.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1194046&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
